Found two P2 issues in [trail 153](https://entire.io/gh/entireio/entire-graph/trails/153), reviewed at `a369233c`:

Reproduced with `go test -race ./internal/cli -run TestRenderVerifyVerdictKeepsTheRunnersOwnFailureExitCodes -count=1`. Copy the baseline inside each subtest before modifying it.

2. **Truncation hides incomplete verification.** [verify.go:776](/Users/thomi/.codex/worktrees/072a/entire-graph/internal/cli/verify.go:776) prioritizes regression IDs over the incompleteness clause. Reproduced a run reporting 40 regressions and exiting 137: `--max-bytes 400` removes both `INCOMPLETE` and the exit status entirely. Preserve both verdict classifications before allocating space to IDs.

Focused verification, shell-wrapper, and cache-bound tests passed; the race-enabled test failed. Remote CI is green, and Entire Gates is blocked only by missing approval. No source changes made.
